# Neo4j Desktop

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Neo4j graph database that support a PKM system.

## Scope note

- Includes knowledge graph, context graph, memory (short-term and long-term), and PKM domain model.

## Broader

- [Graph Database](../GraphDatabase/)
